candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating ReadTimeout through inventory and order to gateway /v1/checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs excluded; root cause within redis (saturation vs network) not established.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout returns 502 with ~2s durations; traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (DependencyUnavailable) cascading via inventory and order ReadTimeouts. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout; redis-side evidence excluded, so residual uncertainty remains.
missing_evidence: Redis dependency metrics (latency, errors, saturation) for inventory->redis to confirm redis-side fault
Inventory service traces/metrics to confirm redis timeout is the origin rather than inventory-side issue
